factors.label: 全球股票
factors.economicMeaning: 全球企业盈利、风险偏好与长期生产率的综合暴露
factors.positiveReturnDefinition: 全球宽基股票总回报减美元现金回报
factors.proxy: licensed global broad equity total-return index
factors.overlapRule: China equity exposure is residualized into china_equity; avoid double counting

factors.label: 名义久期
factors.economicMeaning: 名义增长和政策利率下降带来的长久期债券收益
factors.positiveReturnDefinition: 长期美国国债总回报减1至3年期美国国债总回报
factors.proxy: licensed duration-matched US Treasury total-return indices
factors.overlapRule: duration contribution in credit factor must be hedged out

factors.label: 实际利率
factors.economicMeaning: 实际贴现率下降对长久期与非生息资产的支持
factors.positiveReturnDefinition: 10年期实际收益率周变化的相反数
factors.overlapRule: keep separate from nominal duration and inflation surprise

factors.label: 信用
factors.economicMeaning: 承担企业违约和融资条件风险获得的超额回报
factors.positiveReturnDefinition: 公司债总回报减久期匹配政府债总回报
factors.proxy: licensed broad corporate bond excess-return index
factors.overlapRule: remove matched government duration before estimation

factors.label: 通胀商品
factors.economicMeaning: 商品供需与通胀冲击的可交易暴露
factors.positiveReturnDefinition: 广义商品总回报减美元现金回报
factors.overlapRule: do not add gold-specific narrative exposure outside measured returns

factors.label: 美元
factors.economicMeaning: 美元相对主要贸易伙伴货币升值的暴露
factors.positiveReturnDefinition: 广义贸易加权美元指数的周回报
factors.overlapRule: apply base-currency and hedge convention before aggregating asset beta

factors.label: 中国股票
factors.economicMeaning: 中国增长、政策与本土风险偏好的增量股票暴露
factors.positiveReturnDefinition: 中国宽基股票美元总回报对全球股票因子回归后的残差
factors.proxy: licensed broad China equity total-return index, residualized
factors.overlapRule: must be residualized against equity to prevent duplicate global beta

estimator.fallbackReason: demo return history is shorter than policy minimum and cannot drive risk budgets
